enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running on low to stay cool through the warm night
enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Fan running on low. Turn to left side. Pull sheet up to chest. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend left leg. Straighten left leg. Turn onto back. Place arm under pillow. Turn to left side. Pull sheet down. Turn to right side. Adjust fan speed. Fan continues running on low. Breathe steadily.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering before the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs over edge. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Lather hands. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Wrap towel around waist. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast and drinking chilled water, checking the heatwave warning on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out breakfast items. Close refrigerator. Open microwave. Place food inside. Close microwave. Press start. Wait. Microwave beeps. Open microwave. Take out food. Close microwave. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink chilled water. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open weather app. Read heatwave warning. Put phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing a cold lunch and refilling a water bottle for the hospital shift
enriched_activities.desc: Open refrigerator. Take out lunch container. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out lunch bag. Close cabinet. Place container in bag. Add ice pack. Close bag. Pick up water bottle. Open bottle cap. Turn on tap. Fill bottle with water. Turn off tap. Close bottle cap. Place bottle in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Check phone for bus schedule. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Put on scrubs. Wash hands. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Enter room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Record in chart. Adjust IV drip. Administer medication. Talk to patient. Walk to next patient. Review chart. Write notes. Consult with doctor. Attend meeting. Update records.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break, eating the packed meal and rehydrating
enriched_activities.desc: Sit down in break room. Open lunch bag. Take out container. Open container. Pick up fork. Eat meal. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Close container. Put container back in bag. Stand up. Throw away trash. Wash hands. Return to work area.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work, patient rounds and documentation
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to patient room. Check patient status. Review chart. Write notes. Consult with nurse. Adjust medication. Walk to next patient. Measure vital signs. Record data. Talk to patient. Update electronic health record. Attend briefing. Discuss treatment plan. Walk to nurses station. Review lab results. Document findings.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home after the shift, avoiding the hottest part of the day where possible
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter home. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a light dinner, drinking plenty of water
enriched_activities.desc: Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Close cabinet. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Open cabinet. Take out plate. Close cabinet. Transfer food to plate. Place pot in sink. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Resting on the sofa with the fan on instead of the air conditioner to avoid the evening peak tax
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Adjust fan direction. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get water. Return to living room. Sit on sofa. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the washing machine and running a cool cycle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Pick up laundry basket. Sort clothes. Place clothes into washing machine. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Press power button. Select cool cycle. Press start. Washing machine starts.

enriched_activities.activity: Moving laundry to the dryer and tidying up
enriched_activities.desc: Open washing machine door. Take out wet clothes. Place into dryer. Close washing machine door. Close dryer door. Press start button. Dryer starts. Wipe down washing machine. Sweep floor. Empty trash. Wipe counter. Put away cleaning supplies.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV in bed with the fan on, winding down before sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channels. Lie down on bed. Pull covers up. Watch TV. Adjust pillow. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Turn off fan. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, with the fan running to cope with the hot night
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Eyes closed. Fan running on low. Turn to left side. Pull sheet up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Bend leg. Straighten leg. Turn onto back. Place arm under pillow. Turn to left side. Pull sheet down. Turn to right side. Adjust fan speed. Breathe steadily.
